ComposeFilePathInRepository.description: Path to the Stack file inside the Git repository

EdgeTemplate.description: EdgeTemplate indicates if this template purpose for Edge Stack

IsComposeFormat.description: IsComposeFormat indicates if the Kubernetes template is created from a Docker Compose file

Note.description: A note that will be displayed in the UI. Supports HTML content

Platform.description:
Platform associated to the template.
Valid values are: 1 - 'linux', 2 - 'windows'
Required for Docker stacks

RepositoryAuthentication.description: Use basic authentication to clone the Git repository

RepositoryPassword.description: Password used in basic authentication. Required when RepositoryAuthentication is true.

RepositoryReferenceName.description: Reference name of a Git repository hosting the Stack file

RepositoryURL.description: URL of a Git repository hosting the Stack file

RepositoryUsername.description: Username used in basic authentication. Required when RepositoryAuthentication is true.

TLSSkipVerify.description: TLSSkipVerify skips SSL verification when cloning the Git repository

Type.description:
Type of created stack:
* 1 - swarm
* 2 - compose
* 3 - kubernetes

Variables.description: Definitions of variables in the stack file
